note: Offline reference pins file for the lane enable gate (job glm-lanes-router-lane-enable-gate-q7-20261030; GAPS-vs-S01.md items 5 and 6). Two halves. (1) `cartridges`: the placeholder cartridge catalog verbatim from the registry slice's catalog.example.json, unchanged, so cartctl.py still validates this file -- its validate reads kind and cartridges only. (2) `lane_pins`: this slice's per-lane pin records -- one S01 Pin record (kit schemas/cartridge.schema.json, service.rs:73-79) per admission lane, each marked `model: OPEN-Q7` because the owner's Q7 (which model serves the lane) is unanswered, pointing at the placeholder cartridge, and carrying `owner_approval: null` because no owner approval exists yet. render-blender is not an admission lane and stays exactly as S01 has it: an id-list pin (blender-4.5.14-cycles, main.rs:33), no Pin record. No model is chosen here; every model field stays the placeholder OPEN-Q7 until the owner answers Q7. Nothing behind this file is downloadable, loadable, deployed or bound; every hash, licence and version is a documented placeholder (CARTRIDGES.md in the registry slice). No token appears anywhere in this file.
